gloss: sweet bean paste; red bean paste

definitions.gloss: sweet bean paste; red bean paste
definitions.explanation: a sweet paste made from azuki beans, used as a filling in Japanese confections

examples.japanese: ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{餡子|あんこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Daifuku has sweet bean paste inside.

examples.japanese: {餡子|あんこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Bean paste is made from azuki beans.

examples.japanese: 「⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧「つぶあん」、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餡子|あんこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧？
examples.english: Which bean paste do you prefer, smooth or chunky?

notes:
{餡子|あんこ} is a fundamental ingredient in Japanese confections (⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧).

TYPES:
- ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧: smooth bean paste (strained)
- つぶあん: chunky bean paste (with visible beans)
- {白|しろ}あん: white bean paste (from white beans)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧: rice cake with bean paste filling
- ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧: steamed bun with bean paste
- ⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧: sweet bean jelly
- ⟦{鯛焼|たいや}き→鯛焼き：10363_taiyaki⟧: fish-shaped cake with bean paste
- ⟦どら{焼|や}き→どら焼き：10393_dorayaki⟧: two pancakes with bean paste
- ⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧ / ぼたもち: rice balls coated with bean paste

FORMS:
あん (⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧) is the shorter form and the one used in compounds: あん⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧, ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧, ⟦あんまん→あんまん：30279_anman⟧. {餡子|あんこ} is usually written in kana, あんこ.
